# ultrarouter Python SDK

> Official Python client (package `ultrarouter`, Python 3.10+) for the ultrarouter gateway:
> an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with model routing, fallbacks, evals, Bench comparisons,
> an outcome ledger, preflight with learned context, the learning loop (correlation, verdict
> reports with receipts, learning controls, outcome adapters), and a pure context runtime.
> Sync (`UltraRouter`) and async (`AsyncUltraRouter`) clients with the same surface; typed
> pydantic responses; typed errors; automatic retries.

Version 0.1.0. Not published on PyPI: install from a wheel built from
the repository (`uv build`, then `pip install dist/ultrarouter-<version>-py3-none-any.whl`) or
from the GitHub source. Configure with the `ULTRAROUTER_API_KEY` and `ULTRAROUTER_BASE_URL`
environment variables. Model ids are provider-prefixed (for example `openai/gpt-5.2-mini`).
Read AGENTS.md first for canonical patterns and pitfalls.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/README.md): what the SDK is, install, quickstart (sync and async), configuration, feature tour
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/AGENTS.md): canonical usage patterns, pitfalls, and how to change the repository
- [Guide index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/index.md): every guide with a one-line summary

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/installation.md): from a locally built wheel or the GitHub source (not on PyPI yet); the openai extra; supported Python versions
- [Configuration and authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/configuration.md): API keys, base URL and self-hosted gateways, environment variables, client defaults, autopilot, Bench tagging
- [Sync and async clients](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/clients.md): UltraRouter vs AsyncUltraRouter, lifecycle, connection pools, with_options, concurrency

## OpenAI-compatible surface

- [Chat completions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/chat-completions.md): client.chat.completions.create, parameters, the ur response block
- [Streaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/streaming.md): stream=True, Stream / AsyncStream, final usage and ur
- [Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/tools.md): function calling, tool results, streaming tool-call fragments
- [Structured outputs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/structured-outputs.md): response_format with JSON schema, parsing into pydantic
- [Embeddings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/embeddings.md): client.embeddings.create, float and base64 encodings
- [Models and key info](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/models.md): client.models.list, client.models.retrieve, client.key.get
- [OpenAI compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/openai-compatibility.md): as_openai(), migrating from the openai package
- [Native passthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/passthrough.md): the official openai and anthropic SDKs through the gateway: /v1/responses, /v1/messages, the ur metering headers

## ultrarouter surfaces

- [Call types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/call-types.md): create, configure and evaluate call types; recommendations
- [Hosted prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/hosted-prompts.md): versioned prompts, activation and rollback, get_prompt
- [Prompt rendering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/prompt-render.md): render_prompt and render_hosted_prompt_result
- [Verified memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/verified-memory.md): enable, inspect and disable answering from verified cases
- [Feedback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/feedback.md): thumbs up / down on a served request
- [Generation lookup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/generation.md): tokens, cost, timing and routing for one request
- [Autopilot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/autopilot.md): the routing intent and the readiness report
- [Bench](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/bench.md): capture, freeze, paired runs, reports and the compare gate
- [Outcomes and artifacts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/outcomes.md): artifact types, artifacts, outcome events, finals, the durable queue
- [Plug-and-play learning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/learning.md): request and episode correlation, verdict reports with receipts, outcome adapters, learning controls, the demonstration environment
- [History imports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/imports.md): import usage exports or traces without proxying
- [Flywheel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/flywheel.md): status, exposure grants, candidates, confirmations, plans, improvement reads
- [Oracles and verdict sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/oracles.md): register and qualify your own checks; source checks
- [Reviewer adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/reviewer.md): signed human decisions, dead letters and repair
- [Preflight and learned context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/preflight.md): preflight, use_learned, messages for case modules, caching
- [Learned-module placement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/learned-placement.md): learned_placement_index, apply_learned_context
- [Diff statistics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/diff-stats.md): diff_stats for reporting edits without sending text
- [Context runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/context-runtime.md): ultrarouter.context: lift, compile, render, exit

## Reliability and typing

- [Errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/errors.md): the error classes, codes, statuses and what to do about each
- [Retries, timeouts and idempotency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/retries-timeouts.md): the request policy and how to tune it
- [Typing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/typing.md): pydantic models, request TypedDicts, mypy --strict
- [Testing and mocking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/testing.md): respx, httpx.MockTransport, testing code that uses the SDK
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): common problems and answers

## Examples

- [async_quickstart.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/async_quickstart.py): Send chat completions concurrently with the async client.
- [async_streaming.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/async_streaming.py): Stream a chat completion with the async client.
- [bench.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/bench.py): Capture traffic into a Bench suite, freeze it and run a dry-run comparison.
- [call_types_and_prompts.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/call_types_and_prompts.py): Create a call type, configure it, add and activate a hosted prompt, and trigger an eval.
- [context_runtime.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/context_runtime.py): Lift a conversation into a manifest, compile modules under a contract, and exit again.
- [embeddings.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/embeddings.py): Embed a few texts and rank them by cosine similarity to a query.
- [errors_and_retries.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/errors_and_retries.py): Handle typed errors: an unpriced model, an unknown model and retry settings.
- [hosted_prompt.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/hosted_prompt.py): Fetch the active hosted prompt of a call type and render it locally.
- [learning_ack_loss.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_ack_loss.py): A lost acknowledgement and a repeated report never count twice.
- [learning_async.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_async.py): The learning loop with the async client: an episode, a report, a cancellable receipt wait.
- [learning_controls.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_controls.py): Learning controls for one call type: status, enable, pause/resume, versions, evaluations.
- [learning_delayed_webhook.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_delayed_webhook.py): A delayed outcome from a signed webhook: verified, deduplicated, reported once.
- [learning_immediate_outcome.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_immediate_outcome.py): Report the outcome the moment you have the answer: no sleep, no waiting for persistence.
- [learning_native_verifier.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_native_verifier.py): Native SDK plus a real, computable verifier: the answer is checked, not trusted.
- [learning_openai_client.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_openai_client.py): Keep your existing OpenAI client; add one header and one outcome report.
- [learning_tool_episode.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/learning_tool_episode.py): A multi-step tool episode: every step correlated, one terminal verdict for the whole task.
- [openai_dropin.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/openai_dropin.py): Use the official openai package against the gateway via as_openai().
- [outcomes.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/outcomes.py): Record what happened after an answer: artifacts, outcome events and the edited final.
- [preflight_learned.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/preflight_learned.py): Use learned context on a call you make directly to a provider (no proxying).
- [quickstart.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/quickstart.py): Send one chat completion and print the answer, the served model and the cost.
- [reviewer.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/reviewer.py): Send reviewer decisions through the signed, durable reviewer adapter.
- [streaming.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/streaming.py): Stream a chat completion token by token, then print usage and the ur block.
- [structured_output.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/structured_output.py): Ask for JSON that follows a schema and validate it with pydantic.
- [tools.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucastonon/ultrarouter-sdk-python/main/examples/tools.py): Call a function tool and send its result back to the model.
